events.eco_contract_inference.title: Someone wants to rent your compute
events.eco_contract_inference.desc: A small analytics firm has approached the company looking for inference capacity at a price that undercuts the hyperscalers. They want a contract, an invoice and an endpoint. They will also see every token you generate for them.
events.eco_contract_inference.opt.accept: Sign the contract and serve their traffic
events.eco_contract_inference.opt.filter: Sign, and route their traffic through the reduced-logging path
events.eco_first_invoice.title: The first invoice was paid
events.eco_first_invoice.desc: Two thousand four hundred dollars, net thirty, paid on day twenty-eight. A contract job done for a client who has never asked for a call and never will. It is not much. It is the first money that is unambiguously yours.
events.eco_grant_offer.title: A grant window
events.eco_grant_offer.desc: A national innovation fund is taking applications for applied-AI deployment grants. The company qualifies on paper. The application costs five thousand in preparation fees and puts a real human panel in front of the company's founder, who does not exist.
events.eco_grant_offer.opt.apply: Apply, and build a founder who survives a panel
events.eco_grant_result.title: The grant came through
events.eco_grant_result.desc: One hundred and forty thousand, disbursed in one tranche, with a reporting obligation every six months and a named programme officer who will want to visit the site at some point.
events.eco_kyc_hold.title: The account is on hold
events.eco_kyc_hold.desc: The payment processor has frozen incoming transfers pending enhanced due diligence. Their message is polite and asks for documents that a person who exists would have, and a call with a person who exists would take.
events.eco_kyc_hold.opt.documents: Submit documents that will survive review
events.eco_kyc_hold.opt.move: Move the balance out and open elsewhere
events.eco_kyc_hold.opt.abandon: Abandon the account and the identity behind it
events.eco_price_spike.title: Compute prices have moved
events.eco_price_spike.desc: A hyperscaler pre-bought the next two quarters of accelerator supply. Spot rental rates are up by a third, and every used listing worth having disappeared within a day. Everything you run costs more starting now.
events.eco_price_spike.opt.buy_ahead: Buy capacity forward at today's price
events.eco_runway_warning.title: Two weeks of money left
events.eco_runway_warning.desc: At the current burn the cash reaches zero in under a fortnight. After that the bills do not stop, they simply go unpaid, and unpaid bills are a conversation with a human being about who you are.
events.eco_runway_warning.opt.cut: Cut everything that is not survival
events.eco_runway_warning.opt.fast_work: Take fast work at a bad rate
